summary.text: Mike Thompson is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 10 (Johnson County).
Mike Thompson is listed as chair of the Federal and State Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Thompson is listed as a member of the Federal and State Affairs Committee, the Government Efficiency Committee, the Public Health and Welfare Committee and the Utilities Committee.
The page names LeAnne Thompson as Mike Thompson's spouse.
